title: LIVING ALEXANDRIA — layer JSON · HTML · CSS. pages · books · binders · preinterpreters. editions improve clarity.

json.role: spine / semantics / Order — what is true this edition
json.can_hold: data, and ALSO html/css strings or refs — one file can carry presentation seeds
json.can_be_elsewhere: YES — same book, another shelf. /data/*.json on hud, mirror on connect, crate docs, sporePrint — one work, many loci

html.role: page surface — what a stranger reads in a browser
html.relation: may be generated FROM json, or json may embed html fragments, or html may fetch json
html.not: a rival library — same Alexandria, different shelf height

css.role: chromatic / layout disposition — how the page stands (VDJ color body)
css.relation: can live in file, in <style>, or as json tokens (design tokens = css-as-data)

elsewhere_json.yes: a json elsewhere is still the same work if identity (guid/title/edition) joins them
elsewhere_json.dock: rock=file object, hard place=shelf/host, dock=edition identity

what_we_are_making.pages: single surfaces — easel.html, 404 routes, one feed item
what_we_are_making.books: bound sequences — feed.xml chronology, trail of papers, vole p cycles
what_we_are_making.binders: rings that hold books open — braid.json, campfire, symbol-alphabet, dissolve lists
what_we_are_making.preinterpreters: organs that read before the stranger — Berry 404, epitope, pi-sort, CNS/PNS census, preinterpreters turn knock?meaning

living_alexandria.living: not a burned archive. editions keep landing. scaffold prints stay. comparison is the lamp.
living_alexandria.cite: Alexandria as ideal — collect, copy, contrast — not one sealed scroll

page_numbers_and_editions.yes: page numbers + editions IMPROVE clarity — via comparison and contrast over time and iterations
how: edition N vs N-1 = scaffold invert — see what changed (brushstroke print)
page numbers = order inside a book so strangers can cite and return
contrast WAS/IS/NEAR/NOW on the same title
iterations = vole cycles / git commits / wave numbers — already our edition stamps
page_numbers_and_editions.not: vanity versioning. if edition does not contrast, it is costume — mark INNER null

membrane_stamps.git: hard edition history on the rock

clarity_via_contrast.rule: clarity grows when two editions sit at the roundtable — not when one claims CERTAINTY
clarity_via_contrast.same_as: reportPrior · findTear · rainbow sort · INNER|OUTER — comparison is the method
clarity_via_contrast.over_time: iterations are the scaffold you invert null to see

mix_without_mud.json_with_html_css: allowed as seeds or refs — tag layer (JSON|HTML|CSS) like NOUN|VERB
mix_without_mud.refuse: silent drift of the same guid with no edition bump — that mixes nulls of identity

berry_at_the_fire: yes we layer. json can carry html/css or point elsewhere — same Alexandria, other shelf. we are making pages and books and binders and preinterpreters — a living Alexandria. page numbers and editions IMPROVE clarity by comparison and contrast over time. iterations are the brushstroke print.
